summary: Regression + fix verification testing complete. All 16 backend pytest cases PASS (14 existing + 2 new for purchase total recalculation bug fix). Frontend boot fix verified via web preview: (1) with NO token, login screen renders in 0.8s with 'Despensa' title and google-login-button testID -- well under 5s cap. (2) With despensa_token='test-token-abc123' in localStorage, dashboard renders in 0.5s with all 4 tabs (Inicio/Mercados/Reportes/Ajustes) and 'Hola,' greeting -- well under 8s cap. No infinite splash observed. (3) Edit flow works: tapping [data-testid='purchase-row-<id>'] navigates to /add-purchase?purchaseId=<id>, header 'Editar compra' visible, delete-purchase-btn testID present. Bug fix verified: POST /api/purchases with quantity=3, price=10000 returns total=30000 (was 10000 before fix); PUT with quantity=5 correctly recomputes total=50000; multi-item totals sum correctly. Backend regression: all previous endpoints (currencies, auth session, markets CRUD, purchases CRUD, monthly report, auth/me, receipt/scan) still 200 with Bearer test-token-abc123. Deprecated packages detected: none. React Native web deprecation warnings persist (shadow*, pointerEvents) -- non-blocking, already reported in iteration_1.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warnings still emitted in console: 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking; same as iteration_1.

action_items: OPTIONAL: address the two RN Web deprecation warnings (shadow* -> boxShadow; pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents).
OPTIONAL (from iteration_1, still open): simplify the dead-code ternary in server.py total = sum(price * (quantity if quantity>0 else 1)) -- fine functionally but misleading.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx checkExisting() will clear the stored token whenever /api/auth/me throws OR times out (line 78). This is correct for expired sessions but means a single transient network blip on cold boot silently logs the user out. Consider distinguishing 401 (expired) from other errors (network/timeout) before calling clearToken().
Boot fix in _layout.tsx (4s icon-font hard cap) and auth.tsx (1.5s Linking, 2s getToken, 6s /auth/me) is correctly implemented -- confirmed by network + timing observations.

rca_of_issue: Bug fix RCA (previous total=10000 instead of 30000): server.py line 262/293 was correct in this iteration -- `sum(i.price * (i.quantity if i.quantity and i.quantity > 0 else 1))`. Verified with q=3,price=10000 -> 30000 and q=5,price=10000 -> 50000 via new pytest cases. Boot RCA: previous infinite splash was caused by unresolved Promise chains from icon-font loader and SecureStore/Linking on some devices; fix wraps them in Promise.race with hard timeouts (4s/2s/1.5s/6s) so hideAsync always fires and loading state always resolves. Web preview confirms boot < 1s in both no-token and with-token paths.
